exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press
exercises.notes: DELOAD to 70kg (from 72.5). You completed all 4x5 at 72.5 on 07-20 so this is not a failure response - it is a deliberate re-entry after 9 days off, and a reset of an RPE-10-on-everything pattern that has run for weeks. Target RPE 8 today. If 70 moves at RPE 7 or under, 72.5 comes back next Day A and 75 is live after that. Ignore 07-28: that was the other gym's dual-system smith, the 40kg on it is not comparable to this bar.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: HOLD 17.5kg, reps 12 -> 10. On 07-20 you went 12 / 10 / 8 at RPE 10 - that is a set that fell apart, not a completed set. Own three clean 10s at the same weight before asking for 12s again.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45
exercises.notes: HOLD 145kg, reps 12 -> 10. Last home-gym run was 10 / 8 / 8 at RPE 10, so 10 is the honest target. Partial ROM, knee-friendly depth - do not chase depth to make it feel harder.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: HOLD 7.5kg, reps 12 -> 10. 10 / 10 / 8 at RPE 10 on 7.5kg means the weight is not the problem, the shoulders are pre-fatigued from pressing. Strict form, no swing, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: HOLD 75kg x 15. You completed 3x15 clean on 07-20 - the RPE 10 here is abs burn, not systemic load, so this one stays as-is. Kneeling, facing the stack, crunch with the abs not the hips.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Curl (superset A)
exercises.notes: CALIBRATION SET - 25kg is an estimate, not data. You have no logged cable reverse curl at this gym; 25 is your old 26kg EZ-bar number rounded to the stack. Cable holds tension through the whole curl so it usually feels harder than the bar at the same load. Pick whatever lands at RPE 8 and LOG THE ACTUAL WEIGHT - that number becomes the baseline every future Day A progresses from. Straight into wrist curl with no rest.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl (superset B)
exercises.notes: HOLD 60kg x 10, straight after the reverse curl with no rest. This is real data - you ran exactly 3x10x60 on 07-20. 60s rest AFTER the pair, then move on. Forearms recover fast, so this is the one place a superset costs you nothing.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple-drop, no rest between drops: 47kg to failure -> 35kg -> 26kg. Start weight held at 47 from your 07-20 home-gym run (10 reps). RPE 10 is the point of this one - it is the only exercise today where that is by design.

session_notes: FIRST SESSION BACK AFTER 9 DAYS OFF (last logged: 07-31 B; the 08-03 Day C plan was never run - vacation). Read this as a re-entry session, not a test day. WHAT CHANGED: bench comes down 72.5 -> 70, four rep targets come down 12 -> 10, everything else holds. Nothing goes up. FOREARMS ARE NOW A SUPERSET: standalone Reverse Curl is gone, replaced permanently by Cable Reverse Curl straight into Cable Wrist Curl, no rest between them, 60s after the pair. That is 8 entries on the list but the same time cost as 7 - the superset is why. It also formalises what you were already improvising on 07-20 and 07-28. The wrist curl weight is real (60kg from 07-20); the reverse curl weight is a guess, so log what you actually use. WHY: across 07-20, 07-26, 07-28 and 07-31 you logged RPE 9-10 on nearly every exercise with reps declining inside sets, and wrote 'without energy' and 'very low energy' in the notes. RPE 10 buys no extra muscle retention over RPE 8-9 on a cut, it just costs recovery - and you have been paying that tax for a month. Target today is RPE 8 on the compounds, 7-8 on accessories. The layoff actually helps here: you should feel fresher than the numbers suggest. DATA NOTE: 07-28 was the other gym (dual-system smith bench, super leg press 45) and those weights are machine-specific, so every target above is calculated from 07-20, your last session on these machines. If you are at the other gym again, match RPE not kilos, and say so in the notes. IF IT STILL FEELS LIKE A 10: that is the signal for a real deload week, not another rep trim - tell me and we plan one. WEIGH IN before this session if you can - the last reading is 07-27 (82.6) and it is now post-vacation, so the calorie call is overdue and I need a number that is not two weeks and one holiday old.
